FUN_CODE_0003.name: startup_load_partition_table
FUN_CODE_0003.brief: Read the partition table and hand the address and size of the next program to the hardware.
FUN_CODE_0003.notes: Does not check the table in any way: no checksum, no range check. Prints only the three registers changed by a DUALFW block of slot 1.
FUN_CODE_0003.evidence: slot at 0x6000, or 0x7000 when the marker byte at 0x7FFF is 0xAA; copies the table bytes into the copy-address registers and the share block; prints '[0x%04X] = %02BX' for the DUALFW register changes
FUN_CODE_0003.plain: Part of the boot loader, the first program that runs when the monitor gets power.
